name: Notebook Intelligence
description: AI coding assistant and agent framework for JupyterLab with chat, inline completion and agent mode over notebooks.
whatItDoes: Gives JupyterLab users a chat sidebar, inline completions and an agent that can create and edit notebooks and files. It works with several model providers including fully local ones.
howItWorks: A JupyterLab extension routes requests to GitHub Copilot, OpenAI-compatible or LiteLLM providers, Ollama or Anthropic. It can attach external MCP servers as tools and offers a Claude mode that needs Node.js.

requirements.name: Model provider account
requirements.description: GitHub Copilot, an API key for a compatible provider, or a local Ollama

models: GitHub Copilot, OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM, Ollama, Anthropic
